stemMd: For nonzero x, simplify 6x³ divided by 2x⁻².
explanationMd: Divide coefficients to get 6/2 = 3. For powers of the same nonzero base, subtract exponents: 3 − (−2) = 5. Thus the quotient is 3x⁵. The nonzero restriction makes the negative power meaningful.

distractorRationale.e: This adds the exponents instead of subtracting the negative exponent.
distractorRationale.c: This multiplies coefficients rather than dividing them.
